title: Create keys in bulk: after Create
summary: The New license drawer after Create 200 keys: the one-time CSV before and after its download, the confirmation when closing before any download, and a partial result (120 of 200 created) with Retry the other 80.
compare: After Create the drawer stays open and becomes a one-time panel (ADMIN.md OneTimeSecretPanel): the stepper goes, the title says '200 keys created in <batch>', and the only primary is Download CSV with the file name, rows, columns and size.

After a download the file row reads 'Downloaded at <time>', the button becomes Download again (secondary), an info callout says Download again works until the drawer closes, and Done (primary) closes without asking.

Closing before any download (Close, Esc, × or the scrim) opens 'Close without the CSV?': the keys can't be shown again and would have to be disabled from the batch page. Download CSV is the primary; 'Close without keys' is the danger outline.

Partial result: 'Created 120 of 200 keys'; the CSV covers only the 120 that exist; a warning callout says 80 weren't created with 'Retry the other 80', which adds them to the same batch with their own one-time CSV. No key is made twice.
Open batch is a navigation link in the foot in every state; it goes to the batch page with Disable unused keys.
Phone: a bottom sheet (the kit's .sheet) with the buttons stacked; the confirmation's buttons stack with the primary on top.
